exposure: Program delivery mode (telephone calls or text messages)
Prior experience as a mother (feeling no need for information)
Recruiters' knowledge of and commitment towards the trial
Minimal effort required of women to participate
outcome: Reasons for not consenting to participate
Identification of facilitators in recruiting pregnant women
Identification of challenges in recruiting pregnant women
cohort: The study included 1155 pregnant women (mean gestational age 31.5 weeks) enrolled over 5 months, along with recruiters involved in the process.
finding: Despite challenges, facilitators in recruiting pregnant women to an infant obesity prevention program included the convenient delivery mode via telephone calls or text messages, minimal participant effort, strong organisational support, and dedicated recruiters.
cross-section timing: Data was collected during a 5-month recruitment period for the CHAT RCT.
gest_age: Mean gestational age 31.5 weeks for enrolled pregnant women
